cohort: Pregnant women with 12-24 weeks of gestation who had either a history of >2 spontaneous preterm births or a cervical length <25 mm, with or without a history of spontaneous preterm birth, and carrying singleton pregnancies.
finding: The study found that the preterm birth rate <34 weeks gestation was significantly lower in the pessary group (16%) compared to the progesterone group (34.78%), suggesting cervical pessary can reduce early spontaneous preterm birth.
gest_age: Participants were 12-24 weeks of pregnancy at recruitment; outcomes measured preterm birth at <34 weeks and <37 weeks gestation.
